method: Full AST analysis of Module.body functions in project_evm_service.py; manual review of function bodies, signatures, return structures, and cross-references with integration-inventory.json, CRUD references, and test files. Rev7: revisión semántica completa de las 99 entradas desde el cuerpo real (ecuaciones, guardas, umbrales, salidas/posturas, decisiones y datos); 89 formula_summary reescritas del cuerpo completo y 10 conservadas con validación previa; output_fields = unión exacta de las claves de TODOS los return literals por AST; 19 casos del review r6 más una batería propia ejecutados contra el módulo base con ejecución pura.

entries.name: evaluate_earned_schedule_duration_posture
entries.formula_summary: Postura de duración Earned Schedule (PMBOK §6.6/§7.4). Clamps: planned_duration_days y elapsed_days >= 0 (2 dec), progress_pct [0,100]. earned_schedule_days = round(progress/100 * planned,2); schedule_variance_days = round(ES - elapsed,2); spi_time = round(ES/elapsed,4) si elapsed>0 si no 1.0; estimated_total_duration_days = round(planned/spi_time,2) si spi_time>0 si no planned. posture: 'UNSCHEDULED_DURATION' sin duración planificada; 'COMPLETED_ON_OR_AHEAD' si progress>=100 y elapsed<=planned; 'COMPLETED_LATE' si progress>=100; 'ON_TRACK_DURATION' si spi_time>=0.95; 'AT_RISK_DURATION_SLIP' si spi_time>=0.80; 'CRITICAL_SCHEDULE_DELAY' en otro caso. Devuelve 8 claves: planned_duration_days, elapsed_days, progress_pct, earned_schedule_days, schedule_variance_days, spi_time, estimated_total_duration_days, posture.
entries.rationale: Rev7: la afirmación previa de disponibilidad total era incorrecta. calculate_project_evm expone progress_percentage (avance físico), pero planned_duration_days y elapsed_days requieren datos de cronograma (dates/periods) que el productor no entrega; un consumidor debe derivarlos o mapearlos.

entries.name: evaluate_remaining_investment_viability
entries.formula_summary: Viabilidad de la inversión restante (PMBOK §7.4/§1.2.6). cpi = EV/AC (1.0 si AC=0 con EV>0; 0.0 si ambos 0); effective_cpi = max(cpi, 0.01) si cpi>0 si no 1.0 (piso de estabilidad); etc_forecast = round(max(0,BAC-EV)/effective_cpi,2) solo si BAC>EV (0.0 si ev>=bac); eac_forecast = round(AC+ETC,2); benefit_cost_ratio_at_completion = round(VAN/EAC,4) si EAC>0 si no 0.0; incremental_benefit_to_etc_ratio = round(VAN/ETC,4) si ETC>0, 999.0 si VAN>0 sin ETC (señal de inversión restante vacía con beneficios), 0.0 si VAN nulo. viability_posture: 'NO_INVESTMENT_BASELINE' si BAC<=0 y VAN<=0; 'TERMINATION_OR_RESTRUCTURE_REVIEW' si ratio incremental < 1.0; 'NEGATIVE_NET_BENEFIT_AT_COMPLETION' si BCR < 1.0; 'MARGINAL_INVESTMENT_EFFICIENCY' si BCR>=1.0 con 0<CPI<cpi_floor (default 0.70); 'VIABLE_BUSINESS_CASE' en otro caso; recommendations una acción por postura. Devuelve 12 claves: bac, ac, ev, expected_benefits_npv, cpi, effective_cpi, etc_forecast, eac_forecast, benefit_cost_ratio_at_completion, incremental_benefit_to_etc_ratio, viability_posture, recommendations.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires expected_benefits_npv, cpi_floor which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: bac, ac, ev). Requires data integration or consumer to provide expected_benefits_npv, cpi_floor.

entries.name: evaluate_execution_metric
entries.formula_summary: Resuelve el valor real de un KPI/Indicador desde source_type contra build_project_execution_matrix (o matrix provista). source_type='manual' corta con is_auto=False, current_value=None, spi=None y suggested_target=target_value. Para 16 familias automáticas (pro_edt_progress, tasks_completion_pct, pro_hours_efficiency, hours_logged, pro_cost_efficiency, evm_cpi, pro_milestones_ontime, pro_raid_mitigated, pro_global_health, evm_cr, frente_tiempo_spi, evm_spi, frente_financiero_execution_pct, budget_burn_pct, frente_financiero_rule_100, frente_cruce_ev; fuente desconocida cae al progreso temporal del frente_tiempo) mapea current_value, suggested_target por defecto (100.0 %, 1.0 índices, horas estimadas, EV/BAC), unit y frente desde frente_tiempo/frente_financiero/frente_cruce_evm, con prioridad del componente EDT (component_id en rollup_hierarchy.components) sobre el agregado del proyecto. suggested_target = target_value si > 0, si no el default de la fuente. spi = round(current_value / suggested_target, 4). G6 huérfano: component_id inexistente en rollup_hierarchy.components -> current_value=None, spi=None, orphaned=True, orphan_reason='component_not_present_in_active_edt' (el valor de un componente eliminado no se sustituye por el global). No aplica tolerancia, validez de target_value ni flags de actualización; esa lógica vive en la capa CRUD. Devuelve 10 claves en el flujo automático: is_auto, source_type, frente, current_value, suggested_target, spi, unit, component_name, orphaned, orphan_reason (la rama manual emite 8 claves sin orphaned/orphan_reason).
entries.rationale: Called directly by CRUD create/read/update/sync operations on ProjectKPI/ProjectIndicator endpoints (backend/crud/projects.py:1302,1375,1425,5367,5504,5601,5918,6043,6067). Not called by calculate_project_evm. Does NOT return target_value_valid; that is computed in CRUD layer. Rev6: formula_summary corregida (describe source_type -> current_value, suggested_target/spi y huérfano G6; sin tolerancia ni flags de sync); las 4 referencias duplicadas con línea errónea se reemplazan por la definición real del test en la línea 258.

entries.name: evaluate_control_accounts_concentration
entries.formula_summary: Concentración de variación por Componente EDT Nivel 2 (PMI §5.4/§7.4). Por componente dict lee evm anidado o el propio dict (defaults cpi/spi=1.0, cv/sv=0.0) y health_status. Conteos: crítico si health 'CRITICO*' o cpi<0.85 o spi<0.85; overbudget si cv<0 o cpi<1.0; delayed si sv<0 o spi<1.0; worst_cpi/worst_spi capturan el código (code/name) del peor índice < 1.0. concentration_risk_level: 'none' con lista vacía; 'high' si criticos>=2 o (criticos/total)>=0.5; 'moderate' si 1 crítico o algún overbudget/delayed; 'low' en otro caso. Devuelve 7 claves: total_components, critical_components_count, overbudget_components_count, delayed_components_count, worst_cpi_component_code, worst_spi_component_code, concentration_risk_level.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires components_metrics which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: none). Requires data integration or consumer to provide components_metrics. Sin referencias de test: sin localización confirmada en tests/test_projects_evm.py; no se inventan pruebas.

entries.name: evaluate_work_package_efficiency
entries.formula_summary: Eficiencia de esfuerzo y sobrecosto de un paquete WBS Nivel 3 (PMI §5.3/§7.4). Clamps >=0 (progreso [0,100]): earned_hours = round(est_h*(prog/100),2); hours_efficiency_ratio = round(earned/act_h,2) si act_h>0 si no 1.0; cost_burn_pct = round(act_c/plan_c*100,1) si plan>0 (100.0 con gasto sin plan; 0.0 ambos 0); is_effort_overrun = est_h>0 y act_h>est_h; is_cost_overrun = plan_c>0 y act_c>plan_c. efficiency_status: 'critical_overrun' si ambos overruns; 'warning_drift' si alguno; 'optimal' en otro caso. Devuelve 6 claves: earned_hours, hours_efficiency_ratio, cost_burn_pct, is_effort_overrun, is_cost_overrun, efficiency_status.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires estimated_hours, actual_hours, planned_cost, actual_cost, physical_progress_pct which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: none). Requires data integration or consumer to provide estimated_hours, actual_hours, planned_cost, actual_cost, physical_progress_pct. Sin referencias de test: sin localización confirmada en tests/test_projects_evm.py; no se inventan pruebas.

entries.name: analyze_s_curve_velocity
entries.formula_summary: Velocidad marginal de la Curva S (PMBOK §7.4.2.3). Lista vacía o sin puntos válido -> tendencia 'flat' con contadores 0.0. Deltas marginales no negativos por período: primer delta = max(0, valor), siguientes = max(0, valor_actual - valor_previo) para EV y AC. peak_ev_delta/peak_ac_delta = máximos (2 dec); peak_period_label = label del período del pico de EV. final_sv = round(último EV - último PV); final_cv = round(último EV - último AC). trend_direction: 'flat' si último EV<=0 o peak_ev_delta=0; con >=2 deltas compara el ÚLTIMO delta EV contra la MEDIA de todos los deltas (±1e-6): 'accelerating' si mayor, 'decelerating' si menor, 'steady' en otro caso; con 1 delta 'steady'. Devuelve 7 claves: points_count, peak_ev_delta, peak_ac_delta, peak_period_label, final_sv, final_cv, trend_direction.
entries.rationale: Predictive/specialized function; requires historical data pipeline or specific domain data not in core EVM.

entries.name: evaluate_ieac_forecast_spread
entries.formula_summary: Divergencia entre IEAC(CPI) e IEAC(CPI×SPI) (PMI EVM §4.4). Valores >= 0: spread_amount = round(compuesto - cpi,2) (con signo); con BAC>0: spread_pct_of_bac = |spread|/BAC*100 y overrun_vs_bac_pct = (max(cpi,compuesto)-BAC)/BAC*100; sin BAC ambos 0.0. forecast_reliability: 'unanchored' si BAC<=0; 'convergent' si spread_pct<=10.0; 'moderate_divergence' si <=25.0; 'high_divergence' en otro caso. Devuelve 4 claves: spread_amount, spread_pct_of_bac, overrun_vs_bac_pct, forecast_reliability. Sin referencias de test: sin localización confirmada en tests/test_projects_evm.py; no se inventan pruebas.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires ieac_cpi, ieac_composite which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: bac). Requires data integration or consumer to provide ieac_cpi, ieac_composite. Sin referencias de test: sin localización confirmada en tests/test_projects_evm.py; no se inventan pruebas.

entries.name: predict_schedule_slippage_days
entries.formula_summary: Proyección IEAC(t) = PD/SPI(t) y deslizamiento (Lipke/PMI Earned Schedule). Guardas: PD<=0 -> 5 claves con 0.0/'unscheduled'; spi_t<=0 -> ieac_t_days/projected_slippage_days/slippage_pct = None con 'stalled'. Normal: ieac_t_days = round(PD/spi_t,2); projected_slippage_days = round(ieac_t-PD,2); slippage_pct = (ieac_t-PD)/PD*100. schedule_forecast_status: 'ahead_or_on_time' si slippage<=0; 'minor_slippage' si slippage_pct<=15.0; 'critical_slippage' en otro caso. Devuelve 5 claves: planned_duration_days, ieac_t_days, projected_slippage_days, slippage_pct, schedule_forecast_status.
entries.rationale: Predictive/specialized function; requires historical data pipeline or specific domain data not in core EVM.

entries.name: evaluate_wbs_scope_coverage
entries.formula_summary: Regla del 100% de alcance en WBS (Practice Standard for WBS). total>=0; unassigned clamp [0,total]; assigned = total-unassigned; comps>=0. scope_coverage_pct = assigned/total*100 (100.0 sin tareas); orphan_leakage_pct = unassigned/total*100 (0.0 sin tareas). wbs_scope_status: 'empty_wbs' sin tareas; 'unstructured' con tareas y 0 componentes; 'rule_100_compliant' si unassigned=0 con comps>0; 'minor_scope_leakage' si 0 < leak <= 15.0; 'critical_scope_leakage' en otro caso. Devuelve 7 claves: total_tasks, assigned_tasks, unassigned_tasks, components_count, scope_coverage_pct, orphan_leakage_pct, wbs_scope_status. Sin referencias de test: sin localización confirmada en tests/test_projects_evm.py; no se inventan pruebas.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires total_tasks, unassigned_tasks, components_count which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: none). Requires data integration or consumer to provide total_tasks, unassigned_tasks, components_count. Sin referencias de test: sin localización confirmada en tests/test_projects_evm.py; no se inventan pruebas.

entries.name: evaluate_contingency_reserve_burn_alignment
entries.formula_summary: Consumo de reserva de contingencia vs avance físico (PMBOK §7.4.2.6/§11.7). Clamps >=0 (pct_complete [0,100], 2 dec): remaining_reserve = max(0, allocated-consumed); reserve_burn_pct = consumed/allocated*100 (100.0 con consumo sin reserva; 0.0 ambos 0); burn_to_progress_ratio = reserve_burn_pct/pct_complete si pct>0 (0.0 sin reserva; reserve_burn_pct si pct=0 con consumo); burn_variance_pct = reserve_burn_pct - pct_complete. reserve_alignment_status: 'no_contingency_allocated' sin alocación; 'reserve_exhausted' si consumed>=allocated con avance<100; 'proportional_burn' si consumed>=allocated al 100% o si varianza en [-15.0, 20.0); 'premature_depletion' si varianza>=20.0; 'conservative_preservation' si varianza<-15.0. Devuelve 8 claves: contingency_allocated, contingency_consumed, remaining_reserve, percent_complete, reserve_burn_pct, burn_to_progress_ratio, burn_variance_pct, reserve_alignment_status.
entries.rationale: Rev7: la afirmación previa de disponibilidad total era incorrecta. El productor expone reserves/contingency_reserve y progress_percentage, pero la división alocado/consumido y el percent_complete físico del período requieren seguimiento de consumos que no está en calculate_project_evm.

entries.name: evaluate_cost_schedule_index_csi
entries.formula_summary: CSI = round(CPI * SPI, 4). Guardas: si CPI o SPI es None o <= 0 devuelve 7 claves con csi=0.0, tradeoff_mode='insufficient_data', csi_health_band='unassessed' y recovery_likelihood='unassessed'. tradeoff_mode (umbral 0.95 por índice individual): 'crashing_cost_for_speed' (SPI >= 1.0 y CPI < 0.95); 'under_spending_behind_schedule' (CPI >= 1.0 y SPI < 0.95); 'dual_degradation' (CPI < 0.95 y SPI < 0.95); 'aligned_execution' en otro caso. csi_health_band: 'optimal' si CSI >= 0.95, 'caution' si CSI >= 0.80, 'critical' si CSI < 0.80. recovery_likelihood: 'irreversible_overrun_likely' si CSI < 0.80 y percent_complete >= 20; 'corrective_action_viable' si CSI < 0.95; 'on_track' en otro caso. Devuelve 7 claves: cpi, spi, csi, percent_complete, tradeoff_mode, csi_health_band, recovery_likelihood (no emite posture ni recommendations). Validado por ejecución (rev6): cpi=0.85, spi=1.0, percent_complete=50 -> csi=0.85, tradeoff_mode='crashing_cost_for_speed', csi_health_band='caution', recovery_likelihood='corrective_action_viable'; con CPI=None -> 'insufficient_data'/'unassessed'.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires percent_complete which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: cpi, spi). Requires data integration or consumer to provide percent_complete. Rev6: umbrales corregidos desde el cuerpo real (optimal >= 0.95, caution >= 0.80, critical < 0.80); el caso CPI=0.85 es 'caution', no 'critical' (el 0.9 era un umbral inventado). Sin referencias de test: sin localización confirmada en tests/test_projects_evm.py; no se inventan pruebas.

entries.name: evaluate_variance_at_completion_alert
entries.formula_summary: VAC = BAC - EAC con cobertura por Reserva de Gestión (PMBOK §7.4.2.2). Valores seguros >= 0 (2 dec): cost_baseline_plus_mr = BAC + MR; vac_amount = BAC - EAC (con signo); vac_pct = vac_amount/BAC*100 si BAC>0 si no 0.0; overrun_amount = max(0, EAC - BAC); unfunded_overrun = max(0, overrun_amount - MR); is_covered_by_management_reserve = overrun_amount <= MR. vac_alert_status: 'unbaselined' si BAC=0; 'budget_breach_beyond_mr' si unfunded_overrun > 0 (el sobrecosto supera la MR); 'overrun_absorbed_by_mr' si overrun > 0 y <= MR; 'on_or_under_budget' en otro caso (VAC >= 0). Devuelve INCONDICIONALMENTE 10 claves: bac, eac, management_reserve, cost_baseline_plus_mr, vac_amount, vac_pct, overrun_amount, unfunded_overrun, is_covered_by_management_reserve, vac_alert_status. Ejemplo: BAC=1000, EAC=1200, MR=100 -> techo=1100.0, vac_amount=-200.0, vac_pct=-20.0, overrun=200.0, unfunded=100.0, is_covered=False, 'budget_breach_beyond_mr'. Validado por ejecución (rev7).
entries.rationale: Core EVM diagnostic; all required inputs (bac, eac, management_reserve) available in calculate_project_evm output. Ready for integration when consumer is implemented.

entries.name: evaluate_etc_forecasting_method_posture
entries.formula_summary: remaining_work = max(0, BAC - EV) con EV clampado a [0, BAC]. effective_cpi = cpi provisto si > 0, si no EV/AC, si no 1.0; effective_spi = spi provisto si > 0, si no 1.0. Tres fórmulas canónicas de ETC: etc_atypical = remaining_work; etc_typical_cpi = remaining_work / effective_cpi; etc_composite_cpi_spi = remaining_work / (effective_cpi * effective_spi). recommended_method: 'COMPLETED_NO_ETC' si remaining_work = 0; 'COMPOSITE_CPI_SPI' si effective_cpi < 0.95 y effective_spi < 0.95; 'TYPICAL_CPI' si effective_cpi < 0.95; 'ATYPICAL_REMAINING_BUDGET' en otro caso. Devuelve 7 claves: remaining_work, effective_cpi, effective_spi, etc_atypical, etc_typical_cpi, etc_composite_cpi_spi, recommended_method. Validado por ejecución (rev6): bac=1000, ev=400, ac=500, cpi=0.85, spi=1.0 -> remaining_work=600.0, etc_typical_cpi=705.88, recommended_method='TYPICAL_CPI'.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; all required inputs (bac, ev, ac, cpi, spi) available in calculate_project_evm output. Ready for integration when consumer is implemented.

entries.name: evaluate_funding_limit_reconciliation
entries.formula_summary: Totaliza valores seguros >= 0 (2 decimales): total_authorized_ceiling = cap + management_reserve; cap_utilization_pct = actual/cap*100 (100.0 si actual > 0 con cap = 0; 0.0 si ambos 0); funding_headroom = cap - actual; planned_exceeds_cap = cap > 0 y planned > cap; actual_exceeds_cap = cap > 0 y actual > cap. posture: 'UNCONFIGURED_FUNDING_CAP' si cap = 0; 'CEILING_BREACH_CRITICAL' si actual > techo total; 'RESERVE_DRAWDOWN_REQUIRED' si actual > cap sin superar techo; 'RESCHEDULE_REQUIRED_FOR_CAP' si actual <= cap y planned > cap; 'RECONCILED_WITHIN_LIMITS' en otro caso. Devuelve 10 claves: safe_planned, safe_actual, safe_cap, safe_reserve, total_authorized_ceiling, cap_utilization_pct, funding_headroom, planned_exceeds_cap, actual_exceeds_cap, posture. Validado por ejecución (rev6): planned=200, actual=150, cap=150, mr=10 -> techo=160.0, planned_exceeds_cap=True, posture='RESCHEDULE_REQUIRED_FOR_CAP'.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires planned_cumulative_spend, actual_cumulative_spend, periodic_funding_cap which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: management_reserve). Requires data integration or consumer to provide planned_cumulative_spend, actual_cumulative_spend, periodic_funding_cap.

entries.name: evaluate_funding_limit_periods_reconciliation
entries.formula_summary: Por período dict (id por period/id/quarter con fallback 'P-{idx}'): planned = max(0, planned_expenditure si no planned_cost); limit = max(0, funding_limit si no authorized_funds). breached si (limit <= 0 y planned > 0) o (planned > limit + 1e-9); cada breach aporta (planned - limit) a total_funding_shortfall; tight_buffer si sin breach y utilization = planned/limit*100 > max_utilization_buffer_pct (default 95.0); peak_funding_utilization_pct = máximo de utilizaciones con límite > 0 (2 decimales). is_reconciled = sin breaches. funding_posture: 'NO_FUNDING_PERIODS_DEFINED' sin períodos; 'FUNDING_LIMIT_BREACH' con breaches; 'TIGHT_FUNDING_BUFFER_WARNING' con tight buffers sin breach; 'RECONCILED_WITHIN_FUNDING_LIMITS' en otro caso. Devuelve 7 claves: evaluated_periods_count, breached_periods, tight_buffer_periods, peak_funding_utilization_pct, total_funding_shortfall, is_reconciled, funding_posture. Validado por ejecución (rev6): P1 (planned=120, limit=100) -> breach P1, shortfall=20.0, peak=120.0, 'FUNDING_LIMIT_BREACH'.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires periods, max_utilization_buffer_pct which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: none). Requires data integration or consumer to provide periods, max_utilization_buffer_pct.

entries.name: evaluate_cpi_trend_degradation
entries.formula_summary: Análisis de tendencia de una serie de CPI (PMBOK §7.4). Serie limpia: floats no-bool > 0 redondeados a 4 dec; periods_count = su longitud; latest_cpi y average_cpi (1.0 sin serie); consecutive_drops contadas desde el final comparando cada lectura con la anterior; net_drift = round(última - primera,4) si >=2 lecturas si no 0.0. posture: 'INSUFFICIENT_TREND_HISTORY' si <2 lecturas; 'SYSTEMIC_CPI_EROSION' si drops>=3 o (drops>=2 y latest<0.90); 'EARLY_DEGRADATION_WARNING' si drops>=1 y latest<0.95; 'IMPROVING_OR_STABLE_TREND' en otro caso. Devuelve 7 claves: clean_series, periods_count, latest_cpi, average_cpi, consecutive_drops, net_drift, posture.
entries.rationale: Rev7: la afirmación previa de disponibilidad total era incorrecta. calculate_project_evm entrega una lectura puntual de cpi; la serie histórica (cpi_series) exige snapshots previos persistidos por un consumidor.

entries.name: evaluate_rebaselining_otb_threshold
entries.formula_summary: Umbral OTB/Rebaselining formal (PMBOK §7.4). adjusted_bac = round(max(0, BAC + approved_change_delta),2); cpi = round(EV/AC,4) (1.0 si AC<=0 con EV>0; 0.0 si vacíos); tcpi_bac = round((adjusted_bac-EV)/(adjusted_bac-AC),4) si (adjusted_bac-AC)>0 (999.0 con fondos agotados y trabajo pendiente; 0.0 sin trabajo); budget_exhausted = adjusted_bac>0 y AC>=adjusted_bac con EV<adjusted_bac; requires_otb_formal_review = baseline>0 y (exhausted o tcpi_bac>tcpi_bac_ceiling default 1.20). baseline_posture: 'NO_ACTIVE_BASELINE' sin baseline; 'OVER_TARGET_BASELINE_REQUIRED' si exhausted; 'REBASELINING_EVALUATION_RECOMMENDED' si tcpi>ceiling; 'BASELINE_RECOVERABLE' si tcpi>1.0; 'BASELINE_WITHIN_TOLERANCE' si no; recommendations una acción por postura (CCB/OTB/acciones correctivas). Devuelve 7 claves: adjusted_bac, cpi, tcpi_bac, budget_exhausted, requires_otb_formal_review, baseline_posture, recommendations.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires approved_change_delta, tcpi_bac_ceiling which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: bac, ac, ev). Requires data integration or consumer to provide approved_change_delta, tcpi_bac_ceiling.

entries.name: evaluate_management_reserve_release_governance
entries.formula_summary: Gobernanza de liberaciones de Reserva de Gestión (PMBOK §7.4/§11.6). Releases dict con id/release_id (fallback 'MR-n'): amount>=0; es_authorized = sponsor_approved y justification >= 10 caracteres. authorized_mr_released / unauthorized_mr_amount (2 dec) y unauthorized_release_ids. total_released = ambos; remaining_mr = initial - total_released (puede ser negativa); updated_project_budget_total = BAC + initial_MR; mr_burn_pct = released/initial*100 (0.0 sin MR). mr_governance_posture: 'NO_MANAGEMENT_RESERVE' sin MR ni releases; 'MANAGEMENT_RESERVE_OVERRUN' si remaining_mr<0; 'UNAUTHORIZED_MR_DRAWDOWN' con liberaciones no autorizadas; 'GOVERNED_MR_UTILIZATION' en otro caso; recomendación por postura (definir MR, escala CCB/Patrocinador, regularizar o trazabilidad). Devuelve 9 claves: initial_mr, authorized_mr_released, unauthorized_mr_amount, unauthorized_release_ids, remaining_mr, updated_project_budget_total, mr_burn_pct, mr_governance_posture, recommendations.
entries.rationale: Rev7: cálculo corregido; el productor expone bac y management_reserve (saldo), pero initial_management_reserve y los registros mr_releases (sponsor/justificación) requieren un inventario de liberaciones que no está en calculate_project_evm.

entries.name: evaluate_tcpi_recovery_feasibility
entries.formula_summary: TCPI_BAC = (BAC - EV) / (BAC - AC) si queda trabajo y fondos BAC; 0.0 sin trabajo pendiente; 999.0 con fondos BAC agotados (AC >= BAC con EV < BAC). TCPI_EAC = (BAC - EV) / (EAC_efectivo - AC) con EAC provista (>0) o BAC/CPI; mismas reglas 0.0/999.0. cpi = EV/AC (1.0 si AC <= 0). efficiency_jump_required = max(0, TCPI_BAC - CPI); 999.0 con fondos agotados. is_bac_recoverable exige AMBAS condiciones: not is_bac_funds_exhausted AND TCPI_BAC <= max_feasible_tcpi AND efficiency_jump_required <= max_efficiency_jump. recovery_posture: 'NO_BASELINE_BUDGET' si BAC <= 0; 'BAC_FUNDS_EXHAUSTED_REBASELINE_REQUIRED' si fondos agotados; 'UNRECOVERABLE_BAC_ADOPT_EAC' si is_bac_recoverable=False; 'STRETCH_RECOVERY_MONITOR_CLOSELY' si recuperable con TCPI_BAC > 1; 'FEASIBLE_BAC_COMPLETION' si recuperable con TCPI_BAC <= 1. Devuelve 7 claves: cpi, tcpi_bac, tcpi_eac, efficiency_jump_required, is_bac_funds_exhausted, is_bac_recoverable, recovery_posture (no emite max_feasible_tcpi, max_efficiency_jump ni recommendation). Validado por ejecución (rev6): bac=1000, ev=100, ac=150 -> cpi=0.6667, tcpi_bac=1.0588, tcpi_eac=0.6667, jump=0.3921, is_bac_recoverable=False, recovery_posture='UNRECOVERABLE_BAC_ADOPT_EAC' (jump 0.3921 > max 0.15); verificados además 'BAC_FUNDS_EXHAUSTED_REBASELINE_REQUIRED' (ac >= bac), 'STRETCH_RECOVERY_MONITOR_CLOSELY' (tcpi_bac=1.0526, jump=0.0581), 'FEASIBLE_BAC_COMPLETION' (tcpi_bac=0.9091) y 'NO_BASELINE_BUDGET' (bac <= 0).
entries.rationale: Core EVM diagnostic; all required inputs (bac, ev, ac, eac) available in calculate_project_evm output. max_feasible_tcpi and max_efficiency_jump are configuration parameters. Ready for integration when consumer is implemented. Rev6: regla de postura corregida desde el cuerpo real; el caso BAC=1000/EV=100/AC=150 es UNRECOVERABLE_BAC_ADOPT_EAC, no STRETCH.

entries.name: audit_work_package_evmt_governance
entries.formula_summary: Filtra paquetes dict con id/wp_id no vacío; lee budget, evmt (default 'PERCENT_COMPLETE'), status (default 'IN_PROGRESS'), claimed_pct clamp [0,100] y duration_periods >= 1. FIXED_FORMULA_CAPS = {'0_100': 0.0, '50_50': 50.0, '20_80': 20.0}: formula_cap_violation_ids agrupa paquetes no cerrados (fuera de COMPLETED/DONE/CLOSED) con fórmula fija que reclaman avance > tope; long_duration_fixed_formula_ids agrupa fórmula fija con duration_periods > 2; loe_share_pct = presupuesto LEVEL_OF_EFFORT / total * 100 (2 decimales). is_evmt_governed exige: > 0 paquetes, sin violaciones de tope, sin paquetes largos con fórmula fija y loe_share_pct <= max_loe_share_pct (default 15.0). evmt_posture: 'NO_WORK_PACKAGES' sin paquetes; 'FIXED_FORMULA_PERCENT_CAP_VIOLATION'; 'FIXED_FORMULA_ON_LONG_WORK_PACKAGE'; 'EXCESSIVE_LEVEL_OF_EFFORT_SHARE'; 'GOVERNED_EVMT_BASELINE'. Devuelve 6 claves: total_work_packages, loe_share_pct, formula_cap_violation_ids, long_duration_fixed_formula_ids, is_evmt_governed, evmt_posture. Validado por ejecución (rev6): lista vacía -> loe_share_pct=0.0 y postura 'NO_WORK_PACKAGES'.
entries.rationale: Audit/governance function; requires governance workflow integration; no production caller found in current codebase.

entries.name: evaluate_control_account_variance_masking
entries.formula_summary: Por paquete de trabajo dict: cv = EV - AC; cv_pct = cv / ref_budget * 100 con ref_budget = bac si no pv; paquete severamente sobrecostado si cv < 0 y |cv_pct| >= masking_threshold_pct (default 15.0). Acumulados: net_control_account_cv = sum(cv); gross_negative_cv = sum(|cv|) de paquetes con cv < 0; gross_positive_cv = sum(cv) de paquetes con cv > 0. is_variance_masked exige 3 condiciones simultáneas: existe al menos un paquete severamente sobrecostado Y gross_positive_cv > 0 Y |net_control_account_cv| < gross_negative_cv * 0.5. masking_posture: 'NO_WORK_PACKAGES' sin paquetes; 'HIDDEN_VARIANCE_MASKING_DETECTED' si is_variance_masked; 'UNMASKED_PACKAGE_OVERRUN' si hay sobrecostos severos sin enmascaramiento; 'UNIFORM_CONTROL_ACCOUNT_HEALTH' en otro caso. recommendations emite la acción concreta por postura (CCB / causa raíz). Devuelve 8 claves: total_packages, net_control_account_cv, gross_negative_cv, gross_positive_cv, severely_overrun_package_ids, is_variance_masked, masking_posture, recommendations. Validado por ejecución (rev6): WP1 (cv=-100 sobre bac=300) + WP2 (cv=+100) -> is_variance_masked=True, 'HIDDEN_VARIANCE_MASKING_DETECTED'.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires work_packages, masking_threshold_pct which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: none). Requires data integration or consumer to provide work_packages, masking_threshold_pct.

entries.name: evaluate_earned_schedule_performance
entries.formula_summary: Cronograma Ganado: proyección de EV sobre la curva acumulada de PV (PMBOK §7.4 / Practice Standard for EVM). DOS contratos en la misma función: (a) kw planned_value_curve provista (contrato legacy): curva no vacía con última >0 y AT>0; si falla -> 'INSUFFICIENT_SCHEDULE_CURVE' con 7 claves (sv_t, spi_t, eac_t, is_on_schedule, schedule_posture); ES = punto/interpolación del EV sobre las PV acumuladas (ev clamp a [0, última]); SPI(t) = ES/AT (1.0 sin AT); eac_t = PD/SPI(t) (PD si SPI(t)<=0) con PD = planned_duration_periods si >0 si no longitud de la curva; posturas por SPI(t): 'CRITICAL_SCHEDULE_SLIPPAGE' <0.85, 'MODERATE_SCHEDULE_DELAY' <0.95, 'ON_OR_AHEAD_OF_SCHEDULE' desde 0.95 (is_on_schedule = SPI(t)>=0.95). (b) cumulative_pv_curve posicional (contrato vigente): si la curva o AT fallan -> 'INSUFFICIENT_PV_BASELINE_CURVE' con 8 claves (sv_time, spi_time 0.0, is_on_time_trajectory False); ES interpolado (clamp fraction [0,1]), sv_time = ES-AT (4 dec), spi_time = ES/AT, estimated_duration_at_completion = planned_duration/spi_time (PD = longitud de la curva), posturas: 'CRITICAL_SCHEDULE_SLIPPAGE' <0.85, 'MODERATE_SCHEDULE_DELAY' <0.95, 'ON_TIME_EARNED_SCHEDULE' <=1.05, 'AHEAD_OF_PLANNED_SCHEDULE' >1.05 (is_on_time_trajectory = SPI(t)>=0.95). Unión de las 13 claves reales de ambos contratos en output_fields. Ejemplo (rev7): EV=50, AT=2, curva [25,50,100] -> ES=2.0, SPI(t)=1.0, 'ON_TIME_EARNED_SCHEDULE'/'ON_OR_AHEAD_OF_SCHEDULE' según contrato. Validado por ejecución (rev6/rev7).
entries.rationale: Core EVM diagnostic with clear inputs/outputs; requires PV curve which is not directly returned by calculate_project_evm. Ready for integration when PV curve data is available.

entries.name: evaluate_burn_rate_runway_sustainability
entries.formula_summary: Runway de burn-rate con bifurcación BAC vs BAC+MR (PMBOK §7.4). Guardas: BAC<=0 o elapsed<=0 -> 7 claves en 0.0 con is_sustainable=True y burn_posture='INSUFFICIENT_BURN_DATA'. Cálculos (2 dec redondeo final): actual_burn_rate = AC/elapsed; remaining_bac = max(0, BAC-AC); sustainable_burn_rate = remaining_bac/remaining_periods (remaining_bac si rem_periods=0); budget_runway_periods = remaining_bac/burn si burn>0 (si no rem_periods); total_funds_runway_periods = max(0, BAC+management_reserve-AC)/burn (runway extendido con la Reserva de Gestión, distinto del de BAC); runway_gap_periods = budget_runway - rem_periods. is_sustainable = AC<=BAC y (rem_periods=0 o budget_runway+1e-9 >= rem_periods). burn_posture: 'BUDGET_EXHAUSTED' si AC>=BAC; 'RUNWAY_SHORTFALL_BEYOND_RESERVES' si rem>0 y total_funds_runway+1e-9 < rem_periods (ni con MR); 'RUNWAY_REQUIRES_MANAGEMENT_RESERVE' si rem>0 y budget_runway+1e-9 < rem_periods <= total_funds_runway+1e-9 (el BAC no alcanza pero BAC+MR sí); 'SUSTAINABLE_BURN_RATE_RUNWAY' en otro caso (no existe buffer ni SUSTAINABLE/WARNING/EXHAUSTED ni recommendations). Devuelve 7 claves: actual_burn_rate, sustainable_burn_rate, budget_runway_periods, total_funds_runway_periods, runway_gap_periods, is_sustainable, burn_posture. Ejemplo: BAC=100, AC=80, elapsed=4, rem=2, MR=40 -> burn=20.0, sustainable=10.0, budget_runway=1.0, total_funds_runway=3.0, gap=-1.0, postura 'RUNWAY_REQUIRES_MANAGEMENT_RESERVE'. Validado por ejecución (rev7).
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires actual_cost, elapsed_periods, remaining_periods which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: bac, management_reserve). Requires data integration or consumer to provide actual_cost, elapsed_periods, remaining_periods.

entries.name: evaluate_cpi_spi_stability_window
entries.formula_summary: Estabilidad de CPI y SPI en ventana de snapshots (PMBOK §7.4). Snapshots dict con period_id (period/snapshot_id/id/label, fallback 'SNAP-idx') y cpi/cost_performance_index, spi/schedule_performance_index; descarta None/bool/<=0 y snapshots con ambos None. Por salto respecto del snapshot previo con dato: is_volatile si |ΔCPI| > max_period_swing+1e-9 o |ΔSPI| > max_period_swing+1e-9 (default 0.15); max_observed_swing = mayor salto observado en CPI o SPI (0.0 con <2 valores). cpi_spread = max(CPI)-min(CPI) si >=2 valores CPI si no 0.0; spi_spread análogo solo con SPI. Ambas bandas se evalúan (no solo CPI) con tolerancia INCLUSIVA +1e-9: is_index_stable exige sin períodos volátiles Y cpi_spread <= max_band_width AND spi_spread <= max_band_width (default banda 0.10). stability_posture: 'NO_SNAPSHOTS_EVALUATED' con is_index_stable=True sin snapshots; 'VOLATILE_PERIOD_SWING_ALERT' con períodos volátiles; 'WIDE_INDEX_DRIFT_BAND' si cpi_spread O spi_spread superan la banda (sin swing crítico); 'STABLE_EVM_PERFORMANCE_WINDOW' en otro caso (no existen STABLE/UNSTABLE ni recommendations). Devuelve 7 claves: evaluated_snapshots_count, cpi_spread, spi_spread, max_observed_swing, volatile_period_ids, is_index_stable, stability_posture. Ejemplo: CPI 1.0->1.0, SPI 1.0->1.3 -> volatility por SPI (salto 0.3>0.15 y banda 0.3>0.10), volatile ['SNAP-2'], 'VOLATILE_PERIOD_SWING_ALERT', is_index_stable=False. Validado por ejecución (rev7).
entries.rationale: Rev7: la afirmación previa de disponibilidad total era incorrecta. El productor entrega CPI/SPI puntuales (calculate_project_evm), pero la ventana de snapshots históricos con umbrales banda/swing requiere el histórico de períodos; no está disponible en el productor.

entries.name: evaluate_reserve_drawdown_velocity
entries.formula_summary: Velocidad de drawdown de reservas (PMBOK §7.4.2.3). Clamps no negativos (defaults: max_burn_velocity_ratio 1.25, mr_cr_count 0). contingency_consumed_pct = used/init*100 (100.0 con consumo sin reserva; 0.0 ambos); remaining_contingency_reserve = max(0, init-used) (2 dec); burn_velocity_ratio = consumed_pct/pct_complete si pct>0 (consumed_pct con pct=0 y consumo; 0.0 sin reservas); has_unapproved_mr_drawdown = mr_used>1e-9 con 0 CR aprobadas; is_contingency_overburned = used>init+1e-9 o ratio>max_ratio+1e-9; is_reserve_healthy = sin drawdown no aprobado y sin overburn. reserve_posture: 'NO_RESERVE_CONFIGURED' sin contingencia ni MR usada; 'UNAPPROVED_MANAGEMENT_RESERVE_DRAWDOWN'; 'CONTINGENCY_RESERVE_EXHAUSTED' si used>=init (o usado>sobre el saldo); 'ACCELERATED_RESERVE_BURN_WARNING' (overburn); 'PROPORTIONAL_RESERVE_DRAWDOWN' en otro caso. Devuelve 7 claves: contingency_consumed_pct, remaining_contingency_reserve, burn_velocity_ratio, has_unapproved_mr_drawdown, is_contingency_overburned, is_reserve_healthy, reserve_posture.
entries.rationale: Rev7: la afirmación previa de disponibilidad total era incorrecta. El productor expone reserves (saldos de contingencia/MR), pero consumed, approved_mr_change_requests_count y percent_complete del período requieren seguimiento de drawdowns.

entries.name: audit_pmb_undistributed_budget_reconciliation
entries.formula_summary: Reconciliación PMB = Control Accounts + UB (PMBOK §7.3/§7.4). Coerción _to_float con defaults (None/bool -> default): bac, control_accounts_total, undistributed_budget, max_ub_share_pct (10.0), tolerance (1.0). Si BAC≈CA≈UB≈0 -> 'NO_PMB_CONFIGURED' con 6 claves reconciliadas (is_pmb_reconciled=True). allocated_pmb_total = CA+UB (2 dec); reconciliation_discrepancy = BAC - allocated; ub_share_pct = UB/BAC*100 (100.0 con UB>0 sin BAC; 0.0 ambos); has_negative_bucket = alguno < -1e-9. is_pmb_reconciled = sin bucket negativo Y |discrepancia| <= tolerance+1e-9 Y ub_share <= max_ub_share_pct+1e-9. pmb_posture (precedencia): 'NEGATIVE_BUDGET_BUCKET_ERROR' > 'PMB_BAC_RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH' > 'EXCESSIVE_UNDISTRIBUTED_BUDGET_HOLDING' > 'RECONCILED_PMB_BASELINE'. Devuelve 6 claves: allocated_pmb_total, reconciliation_discrepancy, ub_share_pct, has_negative_bucket, is_pmb_reconciled, pmb_posture.
entries.rationale: Audit/governance function; requires governance workflow integration; no production caller found in current codebase.

entries.name: audit_eac_forecast_optimism_bias
entries.formula_summary: Sesgo de optimismo gerencial vs pronósticos EAC independientes (PMBOK §7.4.2.2). Guardas: BAC/EV/AC <= 0 -> 7 claves en 0.0 con manager_eac = manager_bottom_up_eac redondeado (0.0 fallback), is_forecast_credible=False y 'INSUFFICIENT_EVM_DATA'. Cálculos: rem_work = max(0, BAC - EV) (clamp, EV sobreganado no da EAC negativo); eac_atypical = round(AC + rem_work,2); eac_cpi = round(BAC/CPI,2); eac_composite = round(AC + rem_work/(CPI*SPI),2) si CPI*SPI > 1e-6 (si no eac_cpi), con CPI = EV/AC y SPI = EV/PV (1.0 si PV<=0). manager_eac = manager_bottom_up_eac si >0 si no eac_cpi. statistical_floor = max(eac_cpi, eac_composite) si CPI<1.0, si no eac_cpi. optimism_gap_pct = round((statistical_floor - manager_eac)/statistical_floor*100,2) SOLO si manager_eac < statistical_floor (positivo; 0.0 en otro caso); umbral max_optimism_gap_pct (default 10.0). forecast_posture: 'UNREALISTIC_BELOW_ACTUAL_COST' si manager_eac < AC - 1e-6 (piso sunk-cost); 'MANAGERIAL_OPTIMISM_BIAS_ALERT' si gap > umbral; 'CONSERVATIVE_COMPOSITE_ALIGNED' si manager_eac >= statistical_floor; 'CREDIBLE_EAC_FORECAST' en otro caso. is_forecast_credible = sin violación de piso y sin sesgo. Devuelve 7 claves: eac_atypical, eac_cpi, eac_composite, manager_eac, optimism_gap_pct, is_forecast_credible, forecast_posture. Ejemplo: BAC=1000, EV=500, AC=600, PV=500, manager=900 -> floor=1200.0, gap=+25.0, 'MANAGERIAL_OPTIMISM_BIAS_ALERT'. Clamp: BAC=1000, EV=1200, AC=600, PV=1000, manager=900 -> rem_work=0.0, eac_atypical=600.0, eac_composite=600.0, floor=eac_cpi=500.0 (CPI=2.0>1), gap=0.0, 'CONSERVATIVE_COMPOSITE_ALIGNED', is_forecast_credible=True. Validado por ejecución (rev7).

entries.name: evaluate_management_reserve_ceiling_utilization
entries.formula_summary: Utilización de MR, ajuste de BAC y techo presupuestal (PMBOK §7.3/§7.4). Guarda original_bac<=0 -> 'NO_COST_BASELINE' con 8 claves neutras (is_mr_governance_sound=False). Drawdowns dict con id/drawdown_id: amount>=0 y sponsor_approved flag; total_drawn suma todos; unauthorized_drawdown_ids sin sponsor. total_project_budget = BAC + initial_MR (2 dec); current_bac = BAC + total_drawn; remaining_management_reserve = initial - drawn; mr_utilization_pct = drawn/initial*100 (100.0 con drawdowns sin MR; 0.0 ambos); exceeds_project_budget_ceiling = drawn > initial+1e-6 o current_eac > total_project_budget+1e-6; is_mr_governance_sound = sin no autorizados y sin breach. mr_posture: 'UNAUTHORIZED_MANAGEMENT_RESERVE_DRAWDOWN' > 'PROJECT_BUDGET_CEILING_BREACHED' > 'HIGH_MANAGEMENT_RESERVE_DEPLETION' (utilización > 75.0) > 'GOVERNED_MANAGEMENT_RESERVE_POSTURE'. Devuelve 8 claves: total_project_budget, current_bac, remaining_management_reserve, mr_utilization_pct, unauthorized_drawdown_ids, exceeds_project_budget_ceiling, is_mr_governance_sound, mr_posture.
entries.rationale: Rev7: la afirmación previa de disponibilidad total era incorrecta. El productor expone management_reserve y total_project_budget (saldos), pero la lista mr_drawdowns y el current_eac del momento exigen un registro de movimientos/consumo.

entries.name: evaluate_evm_funding_runway_exhaustion
entries.formula_summary: Exhaustión de runway financiero AC (PMBOK §7.2/§7.4). kw-only: total_authorized_funding, cumulative_actual_cost, periodic_ac_burn_series, remaining_schedule_periods, min_safety_margin_periods (default 1.0). remaining_funding = round(max(0, autorizado-cum_AC),2); is_overdrawn = cum_AC > autorizado; burns válidos > 0 de la serie -> average/peak (2 dec; 0.0 sin serie); estimated_runway_periods = remaining/average si avg>0 (rem_periods si sin avg con fondos; 0.0 si no); runway_surplus_periods = runway - max(0, rem). runway_status: 'EXHAUSTED' si overdrawn o (remaining=0 con rem>0); 'SHORTFALL_RISK' si runway < rem; 'TIGHT_RUNWAY' si surplus < min_safety_margin_periods; 'HEALTHY_RUNWAY' en otro caso; is_runway_sufficient = status=='HEALTHY_RUNWAY' (no existe exhaustion_posture ni recommendations). Devuelve 8 claves: remaining_funding, is_overdrawn, average_periodic_burn, peak_periodic_burn, estimated_runway_periods, runway_surplus_periods, runway_status, is_runway_sufficient.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires total_authorized_funding, cumulative_actual_cost, periodic_ac_burn_series, remaining_schedule_periods, min_safety_margin_periods which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: none). Requires data integration or consumer to provide total_authorized_funding, cumulative_actual_cost, periodic_ac_burn_series, remaining_schedule_periods, min_safety_margin_periods.

entries.name: evaluate_evm_joint_cost_schedule_index
entries.formula_summary: Índice compuesto costo-cronograma (PMBOK §7.4.2.2). Todos kw-only: cpi, spi, percent_complete, tcpi_bac (default 1.0); floats crudos sin guardas (None lanza TypeError natural). csi = round(CPI*SPI,4); tradeoff_imbalance = round(|CPI-SPI|,4); csi_zone: 'GREEN' si csi>=0.9, 'YELLOW' si csi>=0.8, 'RED' si no; is_past_early_stabilization_point = pct>=20.0; requires_formal_rebaseline = csi<0.8 o tcpi_bac>1.10 o (pct>=20 con csi<0.85); is_jointly_healthy = GREEN y sin rebaseline (no existe posture ni recommendations). Devuelve 6 claves: csi, tradeoff_imbalance, csi_zone, is_past_early_stabilization_point, requires_formal_rebaseline, is_jointly_healthy.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires percent_complete, tcpi_bac which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: cpi, spi). Requires data integration or consumer to provide percent_complete, tcpi_bac.

entries.name: evaluate_evm_earned_schedule_tspi_feasibility
entries.formula_summary: TSPI Earned Schedule sobre deadline (PMBOK §7.4 / Practice Standard for EVM). Guardas: metrics no-Mapping, coerción inválida o PD<=0 / AT<0 / ES<0 -> dict inválido con spi_t=0.0, sv_t_days=0.0, tspi_pd=0.0, tspi_ed=0.0, ieac_t_days=0.0, schedule_posture='invalid_inputs', is_recovery_feasible=False. Cálculos: spi_t = round(ES/AT,4) si AT>0 (1.0 si AT=0 con ES>0; 0.0 si ambos 0); sv_t_days = round(ES-AT,2); remaining_work_days = max(0, PD-ES); tspi_pd = round(remaining_work_days/(PD-AT),4) si PD-AT>0, 0.0 sin trabajo pendiente, 999.0 con plazo original agotado y trabajo pendiente; tspi_ed = round(remaining_work_days/(PD+deadline_extension_days-AT),4) con la misma regla 0.0/999.0; ieac_t_days = round(PD/spi_t,2) si spi_t>0, si no round((PD+extension)*2,2). schedule_posture: 'completed' si remaining_work=0; 'on_track' si tspi_pd<=1.05 y spi_t>=0.95; 'recoverable_within_baseline' si tspi_pd<=1.10; 'recoverable_with_extension' si tspi_ed<=1.10; 'unrecoverable_slippage' en otro caso (minúsculas, sin FEASIBLE/STRETCH/UNRECOVERABLE). is_recovery_feasible = postura en {completed,on_track,recoverable_within_baseline,recoverable_with_extension}. Devuelve 7 claves: spi_t, sv_t_days, tspi_pd, tspi_ed, ieac_t_days, schedule_posture, is_recovery_feasible (no existe max_feasible_tspi ni feasibility_posture). TSPI = trabajo restante / tiempo restante, NO ES/AT: PD=100, ES=40, AT=60 -> SPI(t)=0.6667 pero TSPI_PD=TSPI_ED=1.5 con postura 'unrecoverable_slippage' e is_recovery_feasible=False. Validado por ejecución (rev7).
entries.rationale: Rev7: la afirmación previa de disponibilidad total era incorrecta. Requiere metrics con planned_duration_days, actual_time_days y earned_schedule_days ( Earned Schedule), que calculate_project_evm no emite (expone pv/progress_percentage); se necesita un productor de ES o un mapping del consumidor.

entries.name: evaluate_evm_vac_rebaseline_threshold
entries.formula_summary: Umbral de rebaseline CCB por VAC (PMBOK §7.4). Guardas: metrics no-Mapping, coerción inválida, bac<=0/eac<=0/ev<0/ac<0 -> rebaseline_status='invalid_inputs' con claves 0.0/False. vac = round(BAC-EAC,2); vac_pct = vac/BAC*100; remaining_work = max(0, BAC-EV); tcpi_bac = round(remaining_work/(BAC-AC),4) si BAC-AC>0 (0.0 sin trabajo; 999.0 con fondos agotados); overrun_pct = max(0, -vac_pct). rebaseline_status: 'ccb_rebaseline_required' si overrun_pct > tolerance_threshold_pct (default 10.0) o tcpi_bac > 1.20; 'watch_threshold' si overrun_pct <= tolerance y tcpi_bac > 1.10; 'within_tolerance' en otro caso (minúsculas; no existen WITHIN_TOLERANCE/REBASELINE_RECOMMENDED/REBASELINE_REQUIRED). requires_ccb_rebaseline = status=='ccb_rebaseline_required'. Devuelve 7 claves: bac, eac, vac, vac_pct, tcpi_bac, rebaseline_status, requires_ccb_rebaseline.
entries.rationale: Unconnected diagnostic; requires metrics which are not directly available in calculate_project_evm output (available: none). Requires data integration or consumer to provide metrics.

entries.name: evaluate_evm_tcpi_eac_vs_bac_divergence
entries.formula_summary: Divergencia TCPI(BAC) vs TCPI(EAC) y realismo del EAC (PMBOK §7.4). Guardas: metrics no-Mapping o bac<=0/eac<=0/ev<0/ac<0 -> invalid_inputs con 7 claves en 0.0/False. cpi = round(EV/AC,4) (1.0 si AC<=0 con EV>0; 0.0 si vacíos); remaining_work = max(0, BAC-EV); tcpi_bac = round(remaining_work/(BAC-AC),4) si BAC-AC>0 (0.0 sin trabajo; 999.0 con fondos agotados); tcpi_eac análogo sobre (EAC-AC). tcpi_spread = round(ABS(tcpi_bac - tcpi_eac),4) (diferencia absoluta, sin signo); efficiency_gap_vs_cpi = round(tcpi_eac - cpi,4) (esta sí con signo). divergence_posture: 'completed' sin trabajo; 'unrealistic_eac' si rem_eac<=0 o efficiency_gap_vs_cpi>0.15 o tcpi_eac>1.20; 'rebaselined_aligned' si tcpi_bac>1.10 y tcpi_eac<=1.10 y gap<=0.15; 'baseline_achievable' en otro caso (minúsculas; no existen ALIGNED/DIVERGENT_REBASELINE_REQUIRED ni recommendations). is_eac_realistic = postura en {completed,rebaselined_aligned,baseline_achievable}. Devuelve 7 claves: tcpi_bac, tcpi_eac, tcpi_spread, cpi, efficiency_gap_vs_cpi, divergence_posture, is_eac_realistic. Ejemplo: BAC=1000, EV=400, AC=600, EAC=1200 -> tcpi_bac=1.5, tcpi_eac=1.0, tcpi_spread=+0.5 (abs), efficiency_gap_vs_cpi=0.3333, postura 'unrealistic_eac', is_eac_realistic=False. Inputs: total_contract_ceiling, costs_incurred_to_date, demobilization_and_settlement_expenses; kw-only: claimed_anticipatory_profit_on_unperformed_work (default 0.0), reasonable_profit_rate_on_performed_pct (default 8.0), estimated_cost_to_complete_unperformed (default 0.0), payments_already_received (default 0.0), proposal_submitted_days_after_t4c (default 90), max_t4c_proposal_deadline_days (default 365). indicated_total_cost_at_completion = max(0, incurrido)+max(0, est); is_loss_contract = indicado > techo (techo > 0) -> profit a 0.0; allowable_profit_on_performed = incurrido*rate/100 (0.0 si loss); gross_settlement_before_cap = incurrido+profit+demob; capped_gross_settlement = min(gross, techo+demob) si techo > 0 (gross si no); net_t4c_settlement_payable = max(0, capped-recibido); proposal_timely = 0 <= días <= plazo; disallowed_anticipatory_profit_claimed si profit sobre trabajo unperformed > 0 (prohibido FAR; brecha crítica con fuera de plazo). t4c_settlement_status: 'CRITICAL_DISALLOWED_ANTICIPATORY_PROFIT_OR_UNTIMELY_T4C_BREACH' > 'LOSS_CONTRACT_PROFIT_ZEROED_OR_CAPPED_WARNING' (loss o capped < gross) > 'T4C_EQUITABLE_SETTLEMENT_CLEAN'. Devuelve 7 claves: is_loss_contract, allowable_profit_on_performed, gross_settlement_before_cap, capped_gross_settlement, net_t4c_settlement_payable, proposal_timely, t4c_settlement_status.

entries.name: evaluate_evm_acceleration_claim_overtime_inefficiency_and_shift_premium
entries.formula_summary: Aceleración dirigida/constructiva (PMBOK §6.5/§12.3). Inputs: base_straight_time_hours, overtime_hours_worked, base_hourly_wage; kw-only: overtime_premium_multiplier (default 1.5), brt_fatigue_inefficiency_pct (default 15.0), excusable_delay_days_entitled (default 10), time_extension_days_granted_by_owner (default 0), owner_acceleration_order_or_denial_documented (default True), max_overtime_ratio_pct (default 35.0). ungranted_excusable_delay_days = max(0, entitled-granted); constructive_acceleration_established = días no concedidos > 0 con orden/denial documentado; overtime_ratio_pct = OT/max(1, straight)*100 (0.0 sin straight); overtime_shift_premium_cost = OT*wage*(mult-1) (solo el diferencial de premium); fatigue_lost_hours (curva BRT) = (straight+OT)*pct/100 solo si OT>0; fatigue_inefficiency_cost = lost*wage; recoverable_acceleration_claim = premium + fatiga solo con aceleración constructiva. Brecha crítica: overtime voluntario sin orden (OT>0 sin aceleración) o ratio > 35.0. acceleration_claim_status: 'CRITICAL_VOLUNTARY_UNORDERED_OR_EXCESSIVE_OVERTIME_BREACH' > 'CONSTRUCTIVE_ACCELERATION_RECOVERABLE_WARNING' > 'NO_ACCELERATION_BASELINE_PACE_CLEAN'. Devuelve 6 claves: constructive_acceleration_established, overtime_ratio_pct, overtime_shift_premium_cost, fatigue_inefficiency_cost, recoverable_acceleration_claim, acceleration_claim_status.

entries.name: evaluate_evm_surety_performance_bond_t4d_takeover_and_overpayment
